title: Floodwaters submerge bridge in Isabela, roads in Cagayan

blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY – Rains induced by the shearline overnight have left floods at the Maluno overflow bridge at Benito Soliven town in Isabela while other bridges and roads have remained submerged in floodwaters in Cagayan on Tuesday (November 24), according to collated reports from disaster response offices here. As of 5:52 in the morning, Benito Soliven’s disaster risk reduction management office have been advising motorists to take the alternative route going to and from the Barangay Zamora-Old San Mariano-Minanga road.
